exact_statement: Let p+,p- be complete finite child laws absolutely continuous with respect to a complete inherited mean m, and let prescribed normalized block profiles r+,r- average to pi(m), with finite coarse KL. Let M be the minimum mean KL over complete references R_tau of profiles r_tau and full mean m, and L the mean coarse KL. On each doubly occupied block set a_tau=p_tau(block), kappa_tau=p_tau(.|block), e=r+*kappa+ + r-*kappa- -2m, W=r+^2/a+ + r-^2/a-. On each singly occupied block define o=sum(r_tau*kappa_tau-2m)_+. Then (M-L)*ln(2)>=Phi=sum_double ||e||_1^2/(4W)+sum_single a_tau*o^2/r_tau^2. Phi>0 iff a fine attainability test fails; wholly actual-zero blocks contribute zero and all ghosts remain. The common multiplier1 is optimal even for actual positive-influence Boolean child spectra: f=x*h2 with h2 the two-bit point defect, one block and inherited m=((1+2s)/4,(1+2s)/4,(1-2s)/4,(1-2s)/4), 0<s<1/2, has M*ln2=-ln(1-4s^2)/2, Phi=2s^2 and their ratio tends to1. Its FULL transaction is exactly0, since JS=occupancy=0 and old marginal KL=M. For any declared finite complete adaptive tree with current references and these class constraints, define the original margin A=W-U-CE(P_root,Q_root), with W the owner and U all old debits. Payment requires sum reach*(L+Phi/ln2-JS-D(actual_marginal||inherited_m)-actual_occupancy_KL)<=A; negative terms must be retained. This is generic reference geometry applied to actual Boolean witnesses, not an initial Boolean admission bound or universal necessity claim.

exact_statement: Let p+,p- be any complete finite probability laws, q=(p++p-)/2, and pi any partition. Prescribe block probability profiles r+,r- with (r++r-)/2=pi(q) and r_tau(z)>0 whenever a_tau(z)=(pi p_tau)(z)>0. Among complete reference pairs with pi(R_tau)=r_tau and (R++R-)/2=q at EVERY fine label, the finite minimum M of average KL(p_tau||R_tau) exists and is at least L=average KL(a_tau||r_tau). Equality M=L holds IFF, for every block occupied by both actual children, either r+(z)=a+(z) or p+(.|z)=p-(.|z); singly occupied and zero blocks cause no extra obstruction. Equivalently (r+(z)-a+(z))*(a-(z)*p+(s)-a+(z)*p-(s))=0 for all s in doubly occupied blocks. Failure makes M strictly greater than L. For the actual three-bit Boolean selector with children point-defect2 and character y1, p+=(1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4), p-=(0,1,0,0), partition{0,1}|{2,3}, and r+=r-=(3/4,1/4), the exact optimizer is R+=(1/4,1/2,1/8,1/8), R-=(0,3/4,1/8,1/8). M=1/8+(1/2)log2(4/3), L=(3/4)log2(4/3), and M-L=1/8-(1/4)log2(4/3)>0, certified by16<18. At the TRUE full parent reference, the complete erasure-plus-mean-child-CE increment includes JS and equals M-JS=(1/8)log2[5^5/(2^7*3^4)]<0. Thus the fine gap is not an unpaid net transaction.
